# Puck Dribble Trainer (퍽 드리블 트레이너)

> Puck Dribble Trainer is a free web game that uses the camera on your phone, iPad or laptop to track your puck and stick, so you can train ice hockey stickhandling at home. There is no app to install: it runs in the browser.

퍽 드리블 트레이너는 휴대폰·아이패드·노트북 카메라로 퍽과 스틱을 인식해, 집에서 아이스하키 스틱핸들링을 훈련하는 무료 웹 게임입니다. 앱 설치 없이 브라우저에서 바로 시작합니다.

## Key facts
- Price: free to play. Members (joined with an invite code) also get leaderboards and community posting.
- Devices: iPad and tablets, iPhone and Android phones, laptops with a webcam. Runs in a modern browser; can be added to the home screen.
- Privacy: the camera video is processed on the device only. It is never saved or uploaded. Visits and plays are counted with Google Analytics without personal details.
- Any object can be the puck: a puck, a ball or a bottle cap that stands out from the floor. A white pad or a plain mat works best.
- Languages: Korean (https://puck-trainer.com/) and English (https://puck-trainer.com/en/).
- Leaderboards: world, country, team and age group (U8–U18, adult, senior).

## The 7 games
- **Arcade** (아케이드): Dodge the red pucks falling down the lane and collect coins. Every change of direction (a touch) scores, and you compete on your score over 1, 3 or 5 minutes. Trains: Side-to-side stickhandling · seeing the play while handling the puck · quick decisions.
- **Dodge** (퍽 피하기): Avoid the red pucks flying in from all four sides of the field. More of them come at once as time goes on. Trains: 360° puck control · stops and changes of direction · reading danger.
- **Wide Dribble** (와이드 드리블): Three drills in a row that take the puck all the way to each side (edge to edge · short touches at both ends · both ends and the middle). The red zones are drawn on the real floor in the camera view, and a touch counts when the center of the puck enters the zone. Each drill starts when you hold the puck in the center for 3 seconds. Trains: Wide stickhandling · reach · rhythm.
- **Figure 8** (8자 드리블): Skate the puck through the gates in a figure 8 around two cones. Pick which cone comes first (left or right) and clockwise or counterclockwise on the game screen. Trains: Forehand–backhand transitions · protecting the puck · keeping control through turns.
- **Quick Hands** (퀵 핸즈): Touch the puck side to side as fast as you can inside the box drawn on the middle of your floor for 20 seconds. Touches outside the box do not count. Trains: Wrist speed · soft hands · short touches.
- **Reaction Target** (반응 타겟): Get the puck to targets that pop up at random spots as fast as you can. Reaction time and travel time are recorded separately. Trains: Reaction speed · first touch · changing direction.
- **Free Practice** (자유 연습): Place numbered points to build your own course and time every lap (cycle). Share a course in the community and race other players on it. Trains: Any drill a coach wants · timed repetitions.
